read.text:
How to read this

Built from the plan's UI features and the statement, not from code: none of these screens exists yet.

Taken from the mod's records: each good's unit and category (GitLab 4bea4e0e), its need and roles (proposals.json), the building names.

Made up: every quantity. Harvests, needs per citizen, storage limits, spoilage and prices are not designed yet (PR, CN, SD, GW.F8).

Open in the design, shown here one possible way: how goods with different units add up within one need (wine in barrels plus spices in crates, CN.F1.T3); whether the panel groups by category or by need.
